newsitem.title: POLAND: BIG broker aggressive portfolio up 43.2 pct. [CORRECTED 16:53 GMT]
newsitem.headline: BIG broker aggressive portfolio up 43.2 pct. [CORRECTED 16:53 GMT]

text.p: (Corrects headline and text throughout from "fund" to "portfolio".)
The aggressive portfolio of BIG-BG SA brokerage has risen 43.2 percent in its first year, the head of the portfolio's management department said on Monday.

Mariusz Dabkowski told a news conference that the portfolio, which beat the 10.6-percent rise of the main WIG index in the same period and the 14.8-percent inflation rate, had total assets of about 50 million zlotys and 120 clients.
Bank Gdanski is currently merging with BIG, whose full name is Bank Inicjatyw Gospodarczych SA .
